$description: Finish vocabulary referenced by materials and products. `wetFloorGuidance` is a first-pass design signal only: `avoid` means the finish is generally slippery when wet; `verify` means suitability depends on the specific product; `typically-suitable` still requires the supplier's slip-resistance data before specification.

stone-polished.label: Polished
stone-polished.description: Ground to a reflective gloss; heightens colour and veining.
stone-polished.maintenance: Shows scratches; acidic cleaners can etch calcareous stone.

stone-honed.label: Honed
stone-honed.maintenance: Shows stains more readily than polished — confirm sealing.

stone-leathered.label: Leathered
stone-leathered.description: Brushed surface with a soft, undulating texture.
stone-leathered.maintenance: Texture holds dirt — specify a suitable cleaning regime.

stone-flamed.label: Flamed
stone-flamed.description: Thermal finish producing a rough, crystalline texture, typically on granite.

stone-natural.label: Natural / cleft
stone-natural.description: Natural split surface with uneven texture.
stone-natural.maintenance: Check flatness tolerances for furniture and level thresholds.

tile-satin.label: Satin
tile-satin.description: Soft sheen between matt and gloss.

tile-structured.label: Structured / anti-skid
tile-structured.description: Textured surface intended for wet or external floors.
tile-structured.maintenance: Texture holds dirt — specify a suitable cleaning regime.

tile-handmade.label: Handmade
tile-handmade.maintenance: Usually sealed — confirm the sealer and maintenance with the maker.

cement-polished.label: Hand-polished cement
cement-polished.maintenance: Periodic re-waxing or sealing — confirm with the applicator.

wood-oil.label: Oiled
wood-oil.description: Penetrating oil finish that keeps the wood's natural feel.

paint-matt.label: Matt emulsion
paint-matt.description: Flat finish that hides surface imperfections.
paint-matt.maintenance: Less washable than higher sheens — confirm the product's washability.

paint-satin.label: Satin
paint-satin.description: Soft sheen for joinery and high-wear walls.

plaster-lime-polished.label: Burnished lime
plaster-lime-polished.description: Lime plaster burnished to a soft sheen.
plaster-lime-polished.maintenance: Confirm suitability near water with the applicator.

plaster-lime-matt.label: Matt lime
plaster-lime-matt.maintenance: Can be marked by contact — allow for touch-ups.

metal-brushed-stainless.label: Brushed stainless steel
metal-brushed-stainless.description: Directional brushed finish on stainless steel.
metal-brushed-stainless.maintenance: Confirm the steel grade for humid or coastal locations.

metal-chrome-polished.label: Polished chrome
metal-chrome-polished.maintenance: Shows water spots in hard-water areas.

metal-brushed-nickel.label: Brushed nickel
metal-brushed-nickel.maintenance: Wipe dry to reduce water marks.

metal-pvd-brushed-brass.label: Brushed brass (PVD)
metal-pvd-brushed-brass.maintenance: Avoid abrasive cleaners. Confirm the coating warranty with the manufacturer.

glass-clear.label: Clear
glass-clear.description: Clear glass. Consider low-iron glass where the green edge tint matters.
glass-clear.maintenance: Shows water marks in shower areas.

glass-fluted.label: Fluted
glass-fluted.description: Reeded glass that diffuses views while admitting light.
